info.title: v2.logistics.update_self_collection_order_logistics
info.description: Use this api to update the order status for buyer to collect the orders directly from your pharmacy. This includes indicating that order is ready for collection, and that the order has been picked up by the buyer. You should call v2.logistics.get_order_detail or v2.logistics.get_package_detail first to get the package_number of such orders.

post.description: Use this api to update the order status for buyer to collect the orders directly from your pharmacy. parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: epoc_image_list
parameters.description: List of image_id for the proof that buyer already collected the order at the store. Required when self_collection_logistics_action is order_collected. Max: 3. You can call the v2.media.upload_image to upload image and get the image_id, for this scenario, please pass the business = 1 and scene = 1.

parameters.name: package_number
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pin
parameters.description: PIN code required for prescription orders when buyer collects at your shop.

parameters.name: self_collection_logistics_action
parameters.description: Order logistics action. available values: - ready_for_collection - order_collected

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_self_collection_order_logistics?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "epoc_image_list": [
        "id-11134284-7r98o-mef6xcoiw1nt15"
    ],
    "package_number": "OFG211171863281841",
    "pin": "123456",
    "self_collection_logistics_action": "order_collected"
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
